**Pass 1 Findings**
1. **[P1] Photon can defect and disclose provider-controlled text on a successful SDK result.**

   **Earliest owner:** Photon SDK success ingress in `client.ts`.  
   **Oracle:** a result with `get id() { throw Error("provider-success-secret") }` produced `Failure(Cause([Die(...) ]))` containing the sentinel.

2. **[P1] `CodexFunctionParameters` accepts scalar values despite requiring a JSON object.**  
   [contracts.ts:221](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/contracts.ts:221) checks only non-null and non-array after JSON validation. The existing “non-object” test checks an array but no scalar.  
   **Earliest owner:** `CodexFunctionParameters` predicate.  
   **Oracle:** `Schema.is(CodexFunctionParameters)` returned `true` for all three scalars.

3. **[P2] The bounded JSON declaration admits values that change during encoding.**  
   [contracts.ts:184](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/contracts.ts:184) uses `Array.every`, which skips sparse slots; the object path also does not require enumerable properties. Because `Schema.declare` preserves the original value, accepted input can encode differently.  
   **Earliest owner:** `isCodexJsonValueAtDepth`.  
   **Oracle:** `{ items: new Array(1) }` passed the Schema, then encoded as `{"items":[null]}`.

4. **[P2] Access tokens and account IDs are not distinct TypeScript types.**  
   [credentials.ts:85](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/auth/credentials.ts:85) feeds the same unbranded schema into both [access-token](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/auth/credentials.ts:90) and [account-ID](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/auth/credentials.ts:126) redaction. Both types therefore reduce to the same `Redacted<string>`.  
   **Earliest owner:** credential Schemas; brand each semantic value before redaction.  
   **Oracle:** an in-memory strict TypeScript compilation assigned `CodexOAuthAccountId` to `CodexOAuthAccessToken` with zero diagnostics.

5. **[P2] SSE decoding applies BOM handling per line and drops colonless `data` fields.**  
   [sse.ts:67](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/sse.ts:67) creates a new `TextDecoder` for every line, so a BOM is stripped from later lines rather than only at stream start. [sse.ts:309](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/sse.ts:309) also ignores `data` without a colon instead of treating it as an empty data field. Both can discard malformed framing and permit a subsequent clean completion.  
   **Earliest owner:** shared SSE line/field state machine.
